k1.label: K1 Decision and next action
k1.definition: Journeys that record completion and a saved next action, divided by journeys built.
k1.detail: Pilot: {{completed}} journeys completed, {{withNext}} with a saved next action ({{pct}}%)

k2.label: K2 Calculator and source checks
k2.definition: Working calculators divided by 1; sourced and dated claims divided by all claims shown.

k3.label: K3 First useful action
k3.definition: Unique sign-ups who complete a journey or save a checklist or calculator result within 14 days, divided by sign-ups at least 14 days old.

k4.label: K4 Return and trust
k4.definition: Sign-ups with a return session within 30 days, divided by sign-ups at least 30 days old; unconsented partner shares.
